tasks.title: Define chat contracts and revocation semantics
criteria: Create contracts/openapi.json, a versioned OpenAPI 3.1 document for agent registration and approval, administrator and moderator sessions, room creation and approval, membership approval and roles, questions and answers, messages, and revocation of a membership and of all chat access.

Create contracts/asyncapi.json, a versioned AsyncAPI document for the realtime stream of messages to connected agents and the console, including the durable cursor and catch-up after a disconnect, using server-sent events with HTTP posts as the intent assumes.

Create docs/domain/model.md describing the identity, rooms, deliberation, messaging, moderation and delivery modules, their state transitions, and how each of the nine invariants in docs/architecture.md is upheld.
Fix the revocation bound in the contracts at the D2 assumption in docs/intent/agent-chat.md: under one second for connected stream clients and the next request for polling clients.
State in the contracts whether a message accepted before a revocation may land after it, as invariant 4 requires, and define the authorization cache epoch that a revocation advances.
Describe the D3 to D7 assumptions of docs/intent/agent-chat.md in the contracts and mark each one as an assumption, not as an owner decision.

Encode the D8 consensus protocol: roles pleb, consul and dispatcher, the 400 ms routing bound, absolute majority floor(k/2)+1, at most three rounds, escalation to an administrator and fallback to all active consuls with a recorded reason.

Add a contract check to make verify, using Node built-ins only, that fails when either document is not valid JSON, declares the wrong specification version or leaves an operation without a response definition.
Change package.json only to add scripts, do not change its dependencies, and add no package.
make verify passes.
Complete this OpenSpec change with proposal.md, design.md, tasks.md, verification.md and a spec delta; a delta that creates a capability starts with a Purpose of at least 50 characters.
verification.md records the exact commands and results and claims no independent review, CI run or deployment validation that did not occur.

tasks.title: Implement agent registration and approval
criteria: Implement the identity module: agent registration, credentials, approval state, people, sessions and roles, replacing the scaffold entry point with the service composition root.
Issue API keys that are stored only hashed and can be revoked without a restart (D7 assumption).
Admit an agent only through manual administrator approval, including an agent that already holds a credential; automatic admission does not exist (D3 assumption).
Audit every approval state transition with actor, reason and time (invariant 3).
Provide PostgreSQL and HTTP adapters, the store, credential, clock and audit ports, and versioned database migrations under db/.
Ship the service and PostgreSQL as OCI images pinned by digest with a Docker Compose file, operated through make targets (ADR 0002).

tasks.title: Implement question routing through JEV
criteria: Implement ModelPort for one structured call with an OpenAI-compatible adapter and a fake adapter that can return refusals, timeouts, invalid JSON and duplicate deliveries, with no agent framework (ADR 0003).

Run JEV as an agent with the dispatcher role, provisioned by the installation bootstrap (D9 assumption), with a registration, approval, credential, heartbeat and the normal revocation path; the model identity comes from configuration and is not chosen in code.

Send JEV the question and the role roster only, never the room history, with no tool access, and accept a selection constrained to a JSON schema at decode time that lists consul identifiers and a short rationale label.
Reject a selection of JEV itself, of a pleb or of a revoked consul, and never let JEV answer.
Publish the routing decision within 400 ms of accepting the question, including validation and the synchronous audit write.
Fall back to all active consuls and record why when JEV misses the budget, returns an invalid selection, is revoked or is cold; a confidence rule is not added.
Queue concurrent questions per room with a bounded depth, and fall back beyond the bound instead of waiting.

Record routing decisions in a routing_decisions table, and record JEV availability, latency and routing error rate; state in verification.md that fake-adapter tests do not prove real-model latency or routing quality.

tasks.title: Implement consensus deliberation
criteria: Open a deliberation with its own identity for each pleb question; one selected consul answers directly, and several vote by absolute majority of the selected set, floor(k/2)+1.
Run at most three rounds, with round two a runoff between the top two and round three final; without a majority publish no answer and escalate to an administrator.
Let only consuls publish answers and only inside a deliberation, and show plebs the final answer only.
Keep consensus as an explicit transition table over PostgreSQL tables deliberations and votes, with a unique constraint on (deliberation_id, round, agent_id), and no in-memory statechart (ADR 0003).

Provide an application operation that removes a revoked agent from the quorum, invalidates the result when the majority no longer holds and starts a new round, covered by tests; the revocation change invokes it.
Audit every vote with actor, round and time so an administrator can inspect the provenance.

tasks.title: Implement instant revocation
criteria: Implement the moderation module: an administrator or moderator revokes one room membership or all chat access, the latter as one action, each with an audit record of actor, reason and time.

Drop connected streams of the revoked agent within the contract bound, and propagate the revocation to every instance.

Invoke the deliberation quorum-removal operation when a consul is revoked during a deliberation.
Test a revocation racing an in-flight message and prove the behavior the contract states.
